parameters.description:
`msg-to-msg91-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your MSG91 destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own MSG91 destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional MSG91 destinations bound per enrollment.

Create an account at msg91.com, then open your dashboard at control.msg91.com to copy your Authentication Key into MSG91_SMS_AUTHKEY. MSG91 requires transactional SMS to go through a pre-approved template with body/title/type variables mapped, so create one in the dashboard and set its Template ID as MSG91_SMS_TEMPLATE. Set MSG91_SMS_TARGETS to the recipient's mobile number, including the country calling code.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment MSG91 destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to MSG91 Flow API
parameters.summary: Send an SMS notification to your own MSG91 destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.
